request.text: I need a new 27-inch IPS monitor with a USB-C input for my laptop. Where in Beirut can I pick one up and what will I pay?

message:
Best checked options:
• Electroslab: MINIFIRE MF27X3 — $115.00, new, 27-inch FHD IPS with USB-C. A Beirut branch is listed, but its street address and branch stock are unconfirmed.
• iSolved IT: ASUS VU279CFE-B — $240.00 including VAT, new, 27-inch FHD IPS, 100Hz and USB-C. Pickup is explicitly offered at its Bourj Hammoud shop (greater Beirut); no street address was published in the checked details. Branch stock is unconfirmed.
• Mobileleb: ViewSonic VP2768a — $545.00, new, 27-inch QHD IPS with USB-C video and 90W laptop charging. Online stock is available, but a pickup address was not verified.
I’d choose the ASUS for a documented pickup option, or the MINIFIRE for lowest cost. Confirm branch availability before travelling, and check that your laptop’s USB-C port supports video output.

product.title: ViewSonic VG2709-MHU 27" Full HD USB-C Monitor with Dual Speakers
product.description:
The ViewSonic VG2709-MHU 27" Full HD USB-C Monitor with Dual Speakers is a 27-inch Full HD display with a vertical refresh range of 48 to 75 Hz, HDMI (v1.4), USB Type-C and analog RGB inputs, and two built-in 2.5 W speakers.
Its stand adjusts for height, swivel, tilt and pivot, which suits long work sessions, shared desks and portrait viewing of documents or code. It is a good fit for office and home-office users who want one cable from a USB-C laptop and do not want separate speakers. Browse more desktop monitors to compare.

Inputs: HDMI (v1.4), USB Type-C and analog RGB
